original_query: with my_customers as (  select distinct c_customer_sk         , c_current_addr_sk  from         ( select cs_sold_date_sk sold_date_sk,                  cs_bill_customer_sk customer_sk,                  cs_item_sk item_sk,                  cs_wholesale_cost wholesale_cost           from   catalog_sales           union all           select ws_sold_date_sk sold_date_sk,                  ws_bill_customer_sk customer_sk,                  ws_item_sk item_sk,                  ws_wholesale_cost wholesale_cost           from   web_sales          ) cs_or_ws_sales,          item,          date_dim,          customer  where   sold_date_sk = d_date_sk          and item_sk = i_item_sk          and i_category = 'Men'          and i_class = 'accessories'          and c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk          and d_moy = 7          and d_year = 1999          and wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74          and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956  )  , my_revenue as (  select c_customer_sk,         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue  from   my_customers,         store_sales,         customer_address,         store,         date_dim  where  c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk         and ca_county = s_county         and ca_state = s_state         and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk         and c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk         and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74         and s_state in ('GA','IL','IN'                     ,'MT','NC','NM'                     ,'OH','OR','TX'                     ,'VA')         and d_month_seq between (select distinct d_month_seq+1                                  from   date_dim where d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7)                            and  (select distinct d_month_seq+3                                  from   date_dim where d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7)  group by c_customer_sk  )  , segments as  (select cast((revenue/50) as int) as segment   from   my_revenue  )   select  segment, count(*) as num_customers, segment*50 as segment_base  from segments  group by segment  order by segment, num_customers  limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH item_filter AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Men'
      AND i_class = 'accessories'
),
qual_customers AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item_filter i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND d.d_moy = 7
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
    UNION
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item_filter i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1999
      AND d.d_moy = 7
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
),
my_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN qual_customers q ON c.c_customer_sk = q.customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956
),
my_revenue AS (
    SELECT mc.c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM my_customers mc
    JOIN customer_address ca ON mc.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN store s ON ca.ca_county = s.s_county
                AND ca.ca_state = s.s_state
    JOIN store_sales ss ON mc.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
      AND s.s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NC','NM','OH','OR','TX','VA')
      AND d.d_year = 1999
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10
    GROUP BY mc.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT segment,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       segment * 50 AS segment_base
FROM (
    SELECT CAST((revenue / 50) AS int) AS segment
    FROM my_revenue
) segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the large UNION ALL over full catalog_sales/web_sales followed by outer DISTINCT with pre-filtered per-branch queries combined by UNION. This deduplicates customer_sk before joining customer and avoids sorting customer+address rows from all sales.
Push item category/class, date (July 1999), and wholesale_cost filters into each sales branch early, reducing rows before the UNION and customer join.
Replace the two scalar date_dim subqueries (d_month_seq+1 to +3 from July 1999) with the equivalent explicit date window d_year=1999 AND d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10, eliminating two InitPlan scans.
Remove the redundant segments CTE by computing the segment expression once in a small inline subquery, keeping the final grouping and ordering semantics unchanged.

Restructure my_revenue using explicit JOIN order: filter customer_address/store by state first, then join store_sales with date/wholesale filters. Recommended supporting indexes: store_sales(ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_wholesale_cost) INCLUDE(ss_ext_sales_price), catalog_sales(cs_sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk), web_sales(ws_sold_date_sk, ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk).
